#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate sanitized _opencode-history-backup.json files for each git repo."""

import json
import os
import re
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

DB_PATH = Path.home() / ".local/share/opencode/opencode.db"

REPOS = {
    "exodus": "~/Desktop/exodus",
    "dr-marta": "~/Desktop/01_Dr Marta",
    "alegriadevivir": "~/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/__ALEGRIA DE VIVIR",

}

# Mapping from repo key to session directory matchers
REPO_MATCHERS = {
    "exodus": ["~/Desktop/exodus"],
    "dr-marta": ["~/Desktop/Dr Marta"],
    "alegriadevivir": ["~/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/__ALEGRIA DE VIVIR"],
    "drmarta-life": ["~/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/__DESIGN & JOY"],
    "opencode-session-archive": ["*"],  # all sessions
}

def ts_to_iso(ts):
    if ts is None:
        return ""
    try:
        dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(ts / 1000, tz=timezone.utc)
        return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    except Exception:
        return str(ts)

def sanitize_string(s):
    if not isinstance(s, str):
        return s
    # Replace home path
    s = s.replace("~", "~")
    # Redact secrets
    patterns = [
        (r'(?i)(api[_-]?key|apikey)["\']?\s*[:=]\s*["\']?[a-z0-9_\-]{16,}["\']?', r'\1="***REDACTED***"'),
        (r'(?i)(auth[_-]?token|access[_-]?token|token)["\']?\s*[:=]\s*["\']?[a-z0-9_\-\.]{16,}["\']?', r'\1="***REDACTED***"'),
        (r'(?i)(password|passwd|pwd)["\']?\s*[:=]\s*["\']?[^"\'\s]{8,}["\']?', r'\1="***REDACTED***"'),
        (r'(?i)(secret)["\']?\s*[:=]\s*["\']?[a-z0-9_\-]{16,}["\']?', r'\1="***REDACTED***"'),
        (r'(?i)bearer\s+[a-z0-9_\-\.]{20,}', r'Bearer ***REDACTED***'),
        (r'(?i)authorization["\']?\s*[:=]\s*["\']?bearer\s+[a-z0-9_\-\.]{20,}["\']?', r'Authorization: Bearer ***REDACTED***'),
    ]
    for pat, repl in patterns:
        s = re.sub(pat, repl, s)
    return s

def sanitize(obj):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        return {k: sanitize(v) for k, v in obj.items()}
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        return [sanitize(v) for v in obj]
    elif isinstance(obj, str):
        return sanitize_string(obj)
    return obj

def get_sessions_for_repo(conn, matchers):
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute("SELECT id, directory, title, model, agent, time_created, time_updated FROM session ORDER BY time_created")
    sessions = []
    for row in cur.fetchall():
        sid, directory, title, model, agent, tc, tu = row
        if "*" not in matchers:
            if not any(directory == m or directory.startswith(m + "/") or directory.startswith(m + " ") for m in matchers):
                continue
        sessions.append({
            "id": sid,
            "directory": directory,
            "title": title,
            "model": model,
            "agent": agent,
            "time_created": tc,
            "time_updated": tu,
        })
    return sessions

def get_turns_for_session(conn, sid):
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute("SELECT id, time_created, data FROM message WHERE session_id=? ORDER BY time_created, id", (sid,))
    turns = []
    for row in cur.fetchall():
        msg_id, msg_time, msg_data = row
        msg = json.loads(msg_data)
        role = msg.get("role", "unknown")
        if role not in ("user", "assistant"):
            continue
        # Get text parts
        cur2 = conn.cursor()
        cur2.execute("SELECT data FROM part WHERE message_id=? ORDER BY time_created, id", (msg_id,))
        texts = []
        reasoning = []
        for prow in cur2.fetchall():
            part = json.loads(prow[0])
            ptype = part.get("type")
            if ptype == "text":
                texts.append(part.get("text", ""))
            elif ptype == "reasoning":
                reasoning.append(part.get("text", ""))
        turn = {
            "role": role,
            "time": ts_to_iso(msg_time),
            "text": "\n".join(texts),
        }
        if reasoning:
            turn["reasoning"] = "\n".join(reasoning)
        if msg.get("agent"):
            turn["agent"] = msg["agent"]
        if msg.get("model"):
            turn["model"] = msg.get("modelID") or msg.get("model")
        turns.append(turn)
    return turns

def main():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    exported_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    
    for repo_key, repo_path in REPOS.items():
        matchers = REPO_MATCHERS[repo_key]
        sessions = get_sessions_for_repo(conn, matchers)
        output = {
            "exported_at": exported_at,
            "source": "OpenCode session database",
            "repository": repo_key,
            "total_sessions": len(sessions),
            "sessions": [],
        }
        for sess in sessions:
            turns = get_turns_for_session(conn, sess["id"])
            output["sessions"].append({
                "id": sess["id"],
                "title": sess["title"],
                "directory": sess["directory"],
                "created_at": ts_to_iso(sess["time_created"]),
                "updated_at": ts_to_iso(sess["time_updated"]),
                "model": sess["model"],
                "agent": sess["agent"],
                "total_turns": len(turns),
                "turns": turns,
            })
        output = sanitize(output)
        out_path = Path(repo_path) / "_opencode-history-backup.json"
        with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(output, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        print(f"Wrote {out_path} ({len(sessions)} sessions, {sum(len(s['turns']) for s in output['sessions'])} turns)")
    conn.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
